scope: Actual H received content reconstruction and original PSNR, after complete CPU frame traces; no selection, new PHY, development or model training

API.extract: receiver_view(trace) -> {rx,recorded_rx_profile}; reads no other trace fields
API.native_adapter: frozen_native_receiver(native,primitives,catalogue) -> Receiver; constructs no model; preserves original flags; fresh IndependentProvider per arithmetic stream
API.reconstruct: Receiver.reconstruct(receiver_view(trace)) -> {image float32(3,256,256), received_tokens int64 or null, summary}
API.evaluation_only: evaluation_diagnostics(result,trace.evaluation_only) after reconstruction; diagnostics never reach reconstruct or render_tokens

receiver_contract.profile: Reconstruct public format from actual rx.header.profile_id and complete bound catalogue; validate redundant rx_profile exactly
receiver_contract.body: Check actual body profile_key and digest(bucket.layout); reparse decoded_bits with frozen parse_body and require all recorded parse fields/status agree
receiver_contract.raw: Decode actual payload bits to actual tokens, including wrong accepted content and partial profiles selected by a wrong accepted legal header
receiver_contract.arithmetic: Only actual payload and received m enter frozen decode_prefix; independent RX-only probability state; bounded30-zero lookahead and exact canonical reencode
receiver_contract.gray: Only actual header rejection, body CRC/length/padding rejection or InvalidCodeStream from canonical source decoding; RGB0.5
receiver_contract.failures: Malformed evidence, inconsistent paid profile/body parse, model/resource errors and invalid renderer outputs raise; they are never converted into successful gray samples
receiver_contract.source_truth: No TX tokens, TX profile, clean image, source ID, labels, actual transmitted stream or correctness flags enter receiver reconstruction
receiver_contract.targets: Original pixels are passed only to the separate post-reconstruction scorer; preserve original uint8-to-float32 /255 then float64 MSE
receiver_contract.cache: No cache implemented in this core. Renderer is injected for a future separately bound exact-RX-input deterministic cache; this version reports no cache use
receiver_contract.accounting: No header or LDPC decoder import/call. CRC/format reparse and source arithmetic decode do not create new packet events; CPU ledger remains authoritative

CPU_input_schema_from_delivery.body_fields: Original decoded_bits, parsed status/CRC/L/padding/payload, profile_key, phy_key; no substitution from TX
